title: OpenClaw Competitive Intelligence: Monitor Every Competitor Move Automatically
summary: OpenClaw agents watch your competitors around the clock — pricing changes, product launches, job listings, and press mentions — and deliver a weekly digest to your team.
body_markdown: Crayon and Klue are purpose-built competitive intelligence platforms starting at $1,500-3,000/month for teams. OpenClaw via Blink Claw costs from about $45/month per agent plus model usage (billed from your workspace credits) and gives you a fully customizable agent that can do anything — not just competitive monitoring. The tradeoff is configuration effort: Crayon is out-of-the-box, OpenClaw requires setup.
